name: Vulkanizer
description: Experimental Vulkan renderer and diagnostics for Geometry Dash

experimental-v2-shared-chains.name: Experimental V2 shared translation chains
experimental-v2-shared-chains.description: Compile verified simple decorations into persistent shared translation chains. Uncertain dependencies retain native ownership. Requires restart. Live validation is in progress.

experimental-resident-rendering.name: Experimental resident decoration rendering
experimental-resident-rendering.description: R1: one selected simple decoration, translation only, visible and within one spatial section. Requires Zink, automatic transforms, culling off and restart. Unsupported cases return to legacy rendering.

resident-decoration-group.name: Resident decoration group
resident-decoration-group.description: Explicit controlled test group. Only one eligible member is owned. Use 0 to disable selection.

experimental-renderer.name: Experimental Zink session
experimental-renderer.description: Verify the experimental GL-to-Vulkan route. Use the Vulkanizer launcher to select Zink before game startup. Changing this setting alone cannot switch the loaded graphics driver. Requires restart.

frame-diagnostics.name: Frame diagnostics
frame-diagnostics.description: Log CPU frame intervals and Cocos phase timings every 1024 frames. When off, diagnostic phase hooks are removed from normal play. Requires restart.

transform-cost-diagnostics.name: Transform cost diagnostics
transform-cost-diagnostics.description: Sample transform and section-processing costs and log aggregate coverage. Intended for short diagnostic runs; requires restart.

experimental-gpu-transform.name: Experimental GPU move/rotation pilot
experimental-gpu-transform.description: Offloads one explicitly selected decorative group through Zink compute with a same-frame batched readback. Unsupported or unsafe batches use vanilla processing. Requires Experimental Zink session and restart.

experimental-gpu-transform-all.name: Experimental automatic transform optimization
experimental-gpu-transform-all.description: Batches ordered move/rotation operations for independent visual objects across simulation steps and resolves them through Zink before visibility updates. Collision objects, references and unsupported trigger dependencies retain CPU processing. Native comparisons and GPU error fallback protect the experimental path. Requires Experimental Zink session and restart.

experimental-transform-culling.name: Experimental transformation culling
experimental-transform-culling.description: Defers off-screen decorative transformations in shared action lists. Conservative swept bounds, camera margins, dependency barriers and bounded queues force resolution before the state is needed. Requires automatic transform optimization and Zink. Unsupported cases use the existing path. Requires restart.

experimental-level-precompile.name: Experimental level precompilation
experimental-level-precompile.description: Prepare eligible trigger group caches when a level loads. Requires automatic transform optimization and Zink. Unsupported levels use the existing path. Requires restart.

experimental-group575-movement.name: Experimental Group 575 movement
experimental-group575-movement.description: Controlled Group 575 test. Shares ordered move/rotation batches while retaining native Player-X-lock calculations and actual CPU dependencies. Requires automatic transforms, Zink, culling off and restart.

gpu-transform-pilot-group.name: GPU transform pilot group ID
gpu-transform-pilot-group.description: Use a dedicated group containing only simple decoration objects. Runtime safety checks reject mixed, gameplay, trigger, or dynamic center/target groups. Set to 0 to disable group selection.
